episodes.synopsis: Mikazuki's group, Tekkadan, is commissioned to escort Kudelia on an inspection of a halfmetal mine. Under Tekkadan's protection, she completes the inspection schedule without incident. But suddenly, Tekkadan finds itself under attack by space pirates.
episodes.title: New Blood

episodes.synopsis: Despite some casualties, Tekkadan successfully repulses the space pirates of the Dawn Horizon Corps. However, it appears that this enemy was just one part of a huge space pirate group, and Orga decides to counterattack in anticipation of further assaults.
episodes.title: In the Midst of Jealousy

episodes.synopsis: Deploying all of its fighting strength, Tekkadan attempts to capture Sandoval Reuters, the leader of the Dawn Horizon Corps. Gjallarhorn's outer lunar orbit joint fleet Arianrhod also joins the battle, turning it into a three-way free-for-all.
episodes.title: Battle Before Dawn

episodes.synopsis: Mikazuki and Orga visit Allium, leader of the ideological group Terra Liberionis, to resolve the issues surrounding the attacks of the Dawn Horizon Corps. Meanwhile, McGillis arrives at Gjallarhorn's Martian branch and offers Tekkadan a certain proposal.
episodes.title: The Trigger of Success

episodes.synopsis: Tekkadan's Earth branch, which is now serving as a military advisor to Arbrau, is consumed with preparing the launch ceremony for the Arbrau Defense Forces. At Makanai's request, Tekkadan takes charge of security for the ceremony venue.
episodes.title: Inauguration of the Arbrau Defense Forces

episodes.synopsis: A conflict between the rival economic blocs Arbrau and SAU breaks out as their armies clash on the Balfour Plain. Tekkadan also joins the battle under the command of Galan Mossa, but its members become exhausted as the war of attrition continues for days.
episodes.title: Silent War

episodes.synopsis: Gjallarhorn receives a mediation request from the SAU. In order to break the prolonged stalemate, McGillis personally enters the battlefield in a mobile suit. Galan's team launches an attack on McGillis, who is whittling down Arbrau's fighting strength.
episodes.title: My Friend

episodes.synopsis: The fighting ends as the rival economic blocs SAU and Arbrau agree to peace negotiations. As they remember their fallen comrades, the members of Tekkadan decide to withdraw from Earth.
episodes.title: Sovereign of Mars

episodes.synopsis: Via a certain matter on Earth, the connection between Tekkadan and McGillis grows even stronger. Meanwhile, the Gundam Vidar, which has been undergoing adjustment by the Arianrhod fleet, finally rolls out.
episodes.title: Vidar Rising

episodes.synopsis: Tekkadan has discovered a huge object at a mine it is managing. Having received a message from Orga about the object's true nature, McGillis decides to pay a secret visit to Mars.
episodes.title: Awakening Calamity

episodes.synopsis: The awakened mobile armor, along with a huge quantity of sub-units, heads for a densely populated area to begin its attack. Tekkadan attempts to hold back the onslaught, but is helpless against its overwhelming power and superior numbers.
episodes.title: Stained Wings

episodes.synopsis: Outnumbered, Tekkadan turns to McGillis for assistance, and launches a mobile armor mopping-up operation. Meanwhile, a strange phenomenon occurs in the Gundam Frames that are confronting the mobile armor.
episodes.title: Battle for Chryse

episodes.synopsis: Mikazuki faces off against the mobile armor. The battle continues with mounting intensity.
episodes.title: Hunter of Angels

episodes.synopsis: Lafter and the other Turbines members take their leave of Tekkadan. Meanwhile, at Teiwaz, the organization's number two Jasley Donomikols plans a new maneuver.
episodes.title: Counsel

episodes.synopsis: Tekkadan has been thwarted in its attempt to rescue Turbines from danger. Orga restrains himself in response to Naze's wishes, but...
episodes.title: Lit by a Blazing Sun

episodes.synopsis: A modest funeral service is held aboard the Saisei. But Jasley has been preparing yet another stratagem.
episodes.title: Natural for a Human

episodes.synopsis: With the repairs to the Barbatos complete, Tekkadan musters its fighting strength. The members ready their resolve for the confrontation with Jasley.
episodes.title: Settlement

episodes.synopsis: Gjallarhorn's Earth headquarters has been captured in a coup d'état by young officers. Among them is McGillis, who heads for a facility underneath the headquarters.
episodes.title: Revealed Intentions

episodes.synopsis: The Arianrhod fleet, led by Rustal Elion, attempts to gather all its forces to fight the coup d'état.
episodes.title: The Man Who Holds the Soul

episodes.synopsis: After many complications, Tekkadan finally joins the battle against the Arianrhod fleet, but...
episodes.title: If This Is the End

episodes.synopsis: Tekkadan revives and launches an attack, aiming to escape the battlefield. Meanwhile, the fight between McGillis and Gaelio becomes increasingly ferocious.
episodes.title: For Whom?

episodes.synopsis: Tekkadan plans to return to its Martian headquarters and start over. The situation, however, has undergone a dramatic reversal.
episodes.title: Scapegoat

episodes.synopsis: Tekkadan is in a difficult predicament. A huge Gjallarhorn force then begins deploying around its Martian headquarters.
episodes.title: Promise

episodes.synopsis: Gjallarhorn intends to launch a mopping-up operation against Tekkadan. The hour of its commencement is drawing steadily closer...
episodes.title: McGillis Fareed

episodes.synopsis: Gjallarhorn begins its Tekkadan mopping-up operation. Facing this, Tekkadan's future is...
episodes.title: Their Place
